# Pulsus Panorama

> Balanced scorecard and OKR software: objectives, measures, targets and initiatives on a live strategy map, cascaded from the board to every department and branch.

This is the official website of Pulsus Panorama: https://aboutpanorama.pulsus.tech/
Pulsus Panorama is part of the Pulsus Intelligence Suite (https://about.pulsus.tech/), made by Tumblehill Labs, a product studio of Tumblehill Holdings LLC. It works on its own.

## What it is

Pulsus Panorama is balanced scorecard and OKR software. It is a balanced scorecard management system. It connects strategic objectives, measures, targets and initiatives on a live strategy map, adds the quarter's OKRs, and cascades the scorecard from the board to every department, branch, hospital or campus that has its own.

## Key features

- Pulse: The month at a glance
- Details: Every measure, and where you enter it
- Strategy map: Objectives, cause and effect, initiatives
- OKRs: Quarterly objectives and key results
- Performance: A heat-map of every measure, every month
- Insights & forecast: The first read, done for you
- Reports & board pack: PDF, PowerPoint and Excel

## Price

- $750 a month, with no charge per person for up to 50 people. For more than 50 people, talk to us.
- Prices in US dollars, as shown on the plans page: https://aboutpanorama.pulsus.tech/plans/
- 14-day free trial, no card needed.
